description: OMOP CDM v5.4 CARE_SITE table — unique identifiers for each location where healthcare delivery is practiced.

fields.label: Care Site ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each care site.

fields.label: Care Site Name
fields.description: The verbatim description or name of the care site as in data source.

fields.label: Place of Service Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a place of service concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the geographic location of the administrative offices of the organization in the location table.

fields.label: Care Site Source Value
fields.description: The identifier for the care site in the source data, stored here for reference.

fields.label: Place of Service Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the place of service as it appears in the source data, stored here for reference.
